posts.title: Feeds – Social Media Network Made in Europe
posts.description: When listening to the Haken dran Podcast today, I learned about Feeds . Feeds is a social network built and hosted in Europe by a team from Mainz. What caught my eye is the “Local Feed”, which shows you what’s happening around you – events, new cafés, the weekend market – instead of yet another endless stream of things from people you’ll maybe never meet.
